frontmatter.name: frontend-design
frontmatter.description: Anti-slop frontend design for web UI — landing pages, portfolios, marketing/product sites, and redesigns. Reads the brief, infers the right direction, and ships interfaces that don't look templated. Real design systems when applicable, audit-first on redesigns, strict pre-flight check. NOT for mobile apps.
frontmatter.when_to_use: When designing or building web UI — components, layouts, color, typography, landing pages, or redesigns. NOT for mobile apps (use mobile-design).
frontmatter.allowed-tools: Read, Write, Edit, Glob, Grep, Bash
